patterns.pattern: EVM wallet env vars use WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY_{NAME} not PRIVATE_KEY_{NAME}. Solana uses SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY_{NAME}.
Most Base and Arbitrum tokens only have USDC liquidity on 1inch/Uniswap. Native ETH swaps return INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY. ALWAYS prefer USDC as buy-side capital on L2 chains.

When available capital (USDC or native) doesn't cover full Kelly-sized position, cap at 90% of available balance rather than falling back to a different token. This ensures trades execute with smaller capital.

DailyFloorGuardian persists to disk and can lock ALL trading with a stale floor. After large drawdowns, position closures, or fresh capital deployment, ALWAYS reset via force_set_floor(). Check output/daily_floor.json on VPS.
Use 50 (neutral) as fallback for missing indicators, never 0. Zero zeroes out the weighted average composite score.

Sequential external API calls in scoring loops are the #1 performance bottleneck. enrich_candidate() makes 6-7 sequential Moralis calls per token. DexScreener has 1-second rate limit per call. ALWAYS parallelize with ThreadPoolExecutor where possible.

DexScreener batch endpoint (GET /tokens/v1/{chain}/{comma_addresses}, max 30) is implemented in dexscreener.py line 203 but NEVER called in the scan loop. Moralis has batch analytics (30/call) and batch pricing (25/call). Always check for unused batch endpoints before adding serial calls.

Inspired by ECC (affaan-m/ECC): Add automatic logging hooks that capture every trade decision (entry/exit/skip) with full context (signals, guardrails checked, outcome). Don't rely on manual triggers for episodic memory.

Inspired by ECC: Trading bot autonomous loops (position monitor, scanner, executor) need circuit breakers. Apply 5-layer guards: (1) max retries, (2) exponential backoff, (3) re-entrancy check, (4) time-based abort, (5) memory throttle.

Inspired by ECC: Periodically cluster accumulated trade experiences to discover emergent patterns — winning signal combos, dangerous market conditions, time-of-day effects. Threshold: only promote patterns after N=3+ successful applications.
